name: SiteScout AI
description: AI-powered client acquisition for web agencies — discover local businesses, audit their websites, score the real opportunities, and carry every lead through to a signed client.
problem: An agency's next client is usually a local business with a weak website, but finding those businesses means scrolling maps, opening sites one at a time and keeping notes in a spreadsheet. SiteScout AI turns that manual sweep into one pipeline: it discovers businesses by industry and location, checks what their sites actually do, separates real opportunities from noise, and keeps the outreach that follows in the same place.
